name: Rally Court
hook: Arcade tennis where your timing aims every shot.
how: Your player runs to the ball by itself; swing as it reaches you. Early goes cross-court, late goes down the line, right on time is a power shot. First to 4 games wins, with a tiebreak at 3–3; doubles once 3 people are here.
controls: Space to swing, K to lob, arrows or WASD to steer (← → aim the serve) · touch: stick, SWING, LOB
uses: The host's browser calls every bounce in or out, keeps the score and plays the bots; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill every empty spot, so alone you play a full match against one.
Each player's longest rally, in shots.
Every player, swing and shot moves for everyone at once.
ideas: Make it a clay court at sunset with orange dust puffs
Add a super shot meter that fills up during long rallies
